dialogue.content: (こんにちは。本日はよろしくお願いします。11時になったら始めさせて頂ければと思います。)
dialogue.English: (Hello. Thank you for coming today. I'd like to begin at 11:00, if that works for you.)

dialogue.content: （こんにちは！こちらこそ宜しくお願い致します）
dialogue.English: (Hello! Thank you, likewise.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。ご相談にいらしてくださり、ありがとうございます。はじめに、年齢と性別、ご相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 47歳女性です。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: I'm a 47-year-old woman. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 中学生の息子についてご相談です。
dialogue.English: I'd like to talk about my son, who is in middle school.

dialogue.content: 生活態度について悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm worried about his lifestyle and attitude.

dialogue.content: 教えて下さり、ありがとうございます。息子さんのことでお悩みなのですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. So you're concerned about your son.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 差し支えない範囲で結構です。生活態度とは、具体的にどのようなところが気になりますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind sharing, could you tell me more specifically what aspects of his lifestyle and attitude concern you?

dialogue.content: 学校がとても緩いこともあり部活も少なく、毎日ただダラダラしています💦
dialogue.English: His school is quite lenient and doesn't have many club activities, so he just lazes around every day. 💦

dialogue.content: どうしてもスマホやゲームばかりで、依存気味です
dialogue.English: He’s always on his phone or gaming, and it feels borderline addictive.

dialogue.content: 自宅ではほぼベッドの上でゲームかスマホをしています
dialogue.English: At home, he's almost always on his bed, either playing games or on his phone.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは心配になってしまいますよね…。今息子さんは、中学校何年生でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very worrying for you. What grade is your son in now?

dialogue.content: 2年生になりました
dialogue.English: He just started his second year of middle school.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今のような状況は、どれぐらい続いていますか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. How long has this situation been going on?

dialogue.content: 中学入学してからなのでちょうど１年くらいです
dialogue.English: It's been about a year, ever since he started middle school.

dialogue.content: １年続いているのですね。中学校２年生ですと、来年は受験も控えているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So it's been going on for a year. As a second-year student, will he have entrance exams to prepare for next year?

dialogue.content: はい、わたしが言っても全く変わりません、、学校は私立なので、普通に行けば高校はそのまま進学できます
dialogue.English: Yes, but no matter what I say, he doesn't change at all. The school is private, so if he attends normally, he can proceed directly to high school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。息子さんは、中学校受験を頑張られて、少しほっとしてのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I see. Perhaps your son worked hard for his middle school entrance exams and is feeling a bit relieved now.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。確かに当初は、ほっとしたのもあったかもしれないですね、、
dialogue.English: Thank you. You're right, he might have been feeling relieved at first.

dialogue.content: ええ、そう思われるのですね。お子さんに変化が見られないと、伝わっていないんじゃないか、このまま変わらないんじゃないか…と不安になってしまいますよね…。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can see why you'd think that. When you don't see any change in your child, it's natural to feel anxious, wondering if you're getting through to them or if they'll ever change.

dialogue.content: はい。。受験も必死にやったとも言えず、滑り止めで受けた学校に通っています。ダラダラした息子を見ると、通うことは本人が決めたのですが、私は後悔しています。。
dialogue.English: Yes... He didn't exactly work desperately for the exam; he's attending a safety school. Seeing him lazing around, even though he decided to go there himself, I regret it.

dialogue.content: 地元の公立にすれば良かったといつも思います
dialogue.English: I always think we should have chosen the local public school.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。そのような状況ですと、中学校でもう少し頑張ってほしいな、という気持ちにもなってしまいますよね…。
dialogue.English: I understand. In that situation, it’s natural to wish he would try a bit harder in middle school.

dialogue.content: はい、本当に時間がもったいないと感じます。心配しても仕方ないのですがこれでいいのか？と不安です。
dialogue.English: Yes, I really feel like he's wasting his time. I know worrying won't help, but I can't help but feel anxious and wonder if this is okay.

dialogue.content: ええ、そのようなお気持ちなのですね。部活や勉強や、何かに打ち込んでくれればよさそうですよね…。
dialogue.English: I hear you. It would be reassuring if he could devote himself to something—club activities, studies, anything.

dialogue.content: 内部進学ができる学校に通っていても、高校受験をする方も一部いらっしゃると思いますが、今は進学についてはどのように考えていますか？
dialogue.English: Even at schools with internal advancement, some students still take high school entrance exams. How are you currently thinking about his progression to high school?

dialogue.content: そうなんです！何でもいいから何か好きなを見つけたり、頑張りたいことを見つけて取り組んで欲しいです。
dialogue.English: Exactly! I want him to find something—anything—he likes or wants to work hard at and commit to it.

dialogue.content: 進学については、私は受験も視野にと伝えています
dialogue.English: As for his advancement, I’ve told him that taking entrance exams is also an option.

dialogue.content: 息子は、友達と一緒がいいからそのまま進学したいらしいです。
dialogue.English: Apparently, he wants to advance directly so he can stay with his friends.

dialogue.content: ええ、そう思われるのですね。今まで、スポーツや趣味など、息子さんは打ち込まれたことは何かありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Has he ever been deeply engaged in anything before, like sports or hobbies?

dialogue.content: 成績も下がる一方なので、どうしたものかと、、
dialogue.English: His grades keep dropping, so I’m at a loss.

dialogue.content: 息子は、小さいころから習い事も好きではなく通わせてもイヤになって辞めることが多くありました。。
dialogue.English: Ever since he was little, he's never really liked extracurricular lessons. We'd enroll him in things, but he'd often grow to dislike them and quit.

dialogue.content: ええ、息子さんと、すでに受験のお話もされているのですね。学校では、お友達と仲良く過ごしているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see—so you’ve already discussed the possibility of exams with him. And at school, it sounds like he gets along well with his friends.

dialogue.content: あなたが息子さんの将来のことを真剣に考えられているからこそ、成績が上がらないと心配になってしまいますよね…。
dialogue.English: It's precisely because you're thinking so seriously about your son's future that you're worried about his grades not improving.

dialogue.content: とにかく小さいころは生き物好きだったのでよく生き物を探しに公園などには行ったのですが…
dialogue.English: When he was little, he loved living creatures, so we often went to parks and such to look for them, but...

dialogue.content: はい、お友達には恵まれて楽しく通っているようです
dialogue.English: Yes, he seems to be blessed with good friends and enjoys going to school.

dialogue.content: せめて普通なら心配しないのですが、一年で上位から最下位近くまで下がってしまいました。
dialogue.English: If he were at least average I wouldn’t be so worried, but within a year he fell from near the top to near the bottom.

dialogue.content: 点数も悪いのですが、素点で引かれて順位がかなり下がっています💦生活態度なんだと思います。。
dialogue.English: His test scores are bad, but his ranking has dropped significantly because points are deducted from his raw score. I think it's due to his attitude.

dialogue.content: 平常点で引かれてでした。
dialogue.English: It was deductions from his class participation and conduct points.

dialogue.content: ええ、息子さんは生き物が好きだったのですね。そのような部活や、理科系の科目等に興味がわくことがあれば、よさそうですね。
dialogue.English: I see, he used to like living creatures. If something like a related club or a science subject sparked his interest, that could be helpful.

dialogue.content: そうなんですよね…ただ今の学校には生物部はなく、、
dialogue.English: That's right... but his current school doesn’t have a biology club.

dialogue.content: ええ、生活態度で順位がひかれてしまうと、学校での生活は大丈夫なのか、と不安になってしまいますよね…。
dialogue.English: I understand. When his ranking drops due to his conduct, it’s natural to worry about how he’s doing at school overall.

dialogue.content: 理科も教科としては、そんなに好きじゃないようです💦
dialogue.English: He doesn’t seem to like science much as a subject, either. 💦

dialogue.content: はい、、私からはいくら言っても耳を貸しません
dialogue.English: Yes... he won’t listen no matter how much I say.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。興味関心も成長すると少しずつ変化することもあるので、生物以外にもいくつか熱中できるものが見つけられれば、少し安心ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. Interests can change as he grows, so it would be reassuring if he could find a few things—other than biology—that he can get absorbed in.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。息子さんは、今の成績について、どう思っているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. How does your son feel about his current grades?

dialogue.content: はい、聞いてみてもゲームしか楽しくないと言います。。
dialogue.English: Yes, when I ask, he just says the only thing he enjoys is gaming.

dialogue.content: さすがにまずいとは思うようですが、同じくらいの成績の友人がいるようで自分だけじゃない、と思っているようです…
dialogue.English: He does seem to think it’s bad, but because he has friends with similar grades, he appears to feel that he’s not the only one.

dialogue.content: 成績も大事だけどまずは生活を見直そうと伝えています。
dialogue.English: I've told him that while grades are important, he needs to review his daily habits first.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お母さまとしては、まず生活を見直すことが第一優先だと考えていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So as his mother, you believe that reviewing his daily habits is the top priority.

dialogue.content: 生活習慣は、具体的にどう変わればいいな、と考えていますか？
dialogue.English: Specifically, what changes would you like to see in his daily habits?

dialogue.content: はい！成績が悪いのも自分の責任なので、やらないで進学できなかったら、それも自分のせいなので、と思っています。生活態度については、子どものうちに少しでも良い習慣を身につけていけたら、、と
dialogue.English: Yes! I believe his poor grades are his own responsibility, and if he can’t advance because he doesn't do the work, that’s on him, too. As for his lifestyle, I just hope he can develop some good habits while he's still a child.

dialogue.content: そうですね。まずはスマホやゲームの時間を決めて、他のやるべきことをやるといったところでしょうか…
dialogue.English: Let's see. I suppose it would start with setting time limits for his phone and games, and making sure he does the other things he needs to do.

dialogue.content: やるべき事とは、宿題や1日1つはやる約束にしている家の手伝い、犬の世話などです
dialogue.English: The things he needs to do are his homework, one household chore per day as we've agreed, and taking care of the dog.

dialogue.content: 他、自分の部屋の整理整頓です
dialogue.English: Also, organizing and tidying his own room.

dialogue.content: ゴミ部屋のような状態です
dialogue.English: It's like a garbage dump.

dialogue.content: ええ、そのように考えているのですね。またお家での過ごし方について、既に息子さんと話をされているのですね。息子さんと真剣に向き合われている気持ちが伝わってきます。お部屋の片づけ以外の約束は、どのぐらい守れていますか？
dialogue.English: I understand, that’s how you’re thinking about it. And you’ve already been discussing how he spends his time at home with him. I can hear how seriously you’re engaging with your son. Aside from tidying his room, how well is he keeping his other promises?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。手伝いは、やったりやらなかったりで週に2、3日、ほんの少しだけですがやってくれます。宿題は、一年生は提出物もやらなかったみたいなので、まずはそれだけはやるように伝えています。本人はやってると言っています。
dialogue.English: Thank you. As for chores, it’s on and off—he does a little, maybe two or three days a week. With homework, it seems he didn’t even turn in his assignments in his first year, so for now, I’ve just told him to at least do that. He says he’s doing it.

dialogue.content: 詳しくは、見せてくれないため把握出来ていません
dialogue.English: I don’t know the details because he won’t show me.

dialogue.content: 犬の散歩はほぼやらず私か夫がやっています
dialogue.English: He hardly ever walks the dog; my husband or I do it.

dialogue.content: 教えて下さり、ありがとうございます。犬の散歩以外のお手伝いを、たまにやっているのですね。宿題の状況など、詳しく把握することは難しいですよね…。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. So he sometimes helps with chores, other than walking the dog. It must be difficult to get a clear picture of his homework situation.

dialogue.content: 仰るように、スマホやゲームの時間を決めることはとてもいいアイデアだと思います。寝る時間が遅くなってしまうと、より生活が乱れてしまう可能性もあるので、Wi-Fiを時間になったら切る、ゲームを回収する等も必要かもしれません。
dialogue.English: As you said, I think setting time limits for his phone and games is an excellent idea. If he stays up late, his lifestyle could become even more disrupted, so it might be necessary to do things like turning off the Wi-Fi at a certain time or collecting his gaming devices.

dialogue.content: はい、簡単な手伝いですが渋々やってくれます。宿題については、カバンやプリントを見ると怒り出しケンカになるので塾の先生に任せています💦
dialogue.English: Yes, they’re simple chores, but he does them grudgingly. As for his homework, if I look in his bag or at his worksheets he gets angry and we end up fighting, so I’ve left that to his cram school teacher. 💦

dialogue.content: はい、何度も話し合い制限もつけたりするのですがどうやってかクリアしてしまっていました💦ほとほと困り、取り上げたこともありましたが大暴れで関係が悪くなり無理矢理ではない方法を探しています。。
dialogue.English: Yes, we’ve talked about it many times and set limits, but he somehow manages to get around them. 💦 I was at my wits’ end and once confiscated his devices, but he threw a huge tantrum and it damaged our relationship, so now I’m looking for a method that isn’t forceful.

dialogue.content: 子供に家の手伝いをしてもらうことは、難しい場合も多いと思います。その中で息子さんが、お母さまとの約束を気にして、意識をしているのかな、とも思います。
dialogue.English: Getting children to help around the house can often be difficult. In light of that, it sounds like your son is at least mindful of the agreements he has with you.

dialogue.content: 無理強いすると学校にはもう行かない、と言うのでそれなら、それも自分の人生だからいいよ　と伝えてきました。そして実際、朝出ても登校しない日もありました。息子から、無理やりやっていい事何かあるか？と言われ、その後自ら息子が気付かないと無意味なんだな、、と思いました💦
dialogue.English: When I push him, he says he won’t go to school anymore, so I’ve told him, "Fine, it’s your life." And in fact, there have been days when he left in the morning but didn’t actually go to school. He asked me, "What good ever comes from forcing someone to do something?" and after that, I realized it’s pointless unless he figures it out for himself. 💦

dialogue.content: そうですね！
dialogue.English: That's true!

dialogue.content: そう言われたら確かに少しは私との約束を守ろうという意識は少しはあるんだと思います！
dialogue.English: Putting it that way, I suppose he does have at least some intention of keeping his promises to me!

dialogue.content: 中学生の男の子は思春期で、とても難しい年ごろだと思います。その中で、息子さんと今後についてしっかりコミュニケーションを取り、息子さんもお母さまとの約束を少し意識している状況は、お母さまの愛情と努力の賜物だと私は思います。お母さまの息子さんを思う気持ちは、しっかり伝わっていると私は思います。
dialogue.English: Boys in middle school are going through adolescence, which can be a very challenging time. The fact that you’re communicating with him about the future and that he’s at least somewhat mindful of your agreements, I believe, is a testament to your love and effort. I truly believe your care for him is getting through.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。そうなんですかね、認めいただき嬉しいです、息子が意識しているという点に目を向けていきます。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I suppose that might be true. I’m glad to have that acknowledged, and I’ll try to focus on the fact that he is being mindful.

dialogue.content: 仰る通り、息子さんも自分で気づくことが大事なのかもしれませんね。学校に行く意味や、何をしたいのかすべきなのか、色々と考えている年齢かもしれません。
dialogue.English: As you said, it may be important that he comes to these realizations on his own. He may be at an age where he’s thinking about many things, like the reason for going to school, what he wants to do, and what he should be doing.

dialogue.content: そうですね、、
dialogue.English: I suppose so...

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます😭
dialogue.English: Thank you. 😭

dialogue.content: 育児は悩みの連続で、正解もないのでとても大変だと思います。お子さんの様子もまた変わっていくかもしれないので、よければまたお話聞かせてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Parenting is full of worries and there’s no single right answer, so I know it can be very hard. Your son's situation may change again, so please feel free to talk with me again anytime.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you!

dialogue.content: またお願い致します
dialogue.English: I’d like to consult with you again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お話の途中で申し訳ありませんが、間もなくご相談の終了の時間となります。本日は大切なお話を聞かせて頂き、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I’m sorry to interrupt, but we’re almost at the end of our time for today. Thank you for sharing such important matters with me.

dialogue.content: 日々家族の為に頑張るあなたを、これからも応援したいと思います。
dialogue.English: I want to continue supporting you as you do your best for your family every day.

dialogue.content: 本日は聞いていただきありがとうございました。応援いただき嬉しいです。また宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening today. I appreciate your support, and I look forward to speaking with you again.

dialogue.content: (お付き合いいただき、ありがとうございました。よろしければ終了させていただきます。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time. If it’s alright with you, we’ll wrap up here.)

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much!
